v1.4.7 Update
🐛 Route-prefix hosting: Unboxing now loads correctly when Foundry is hosted under a URL route prefix.
🐛 Hidden journal buttons: Linked journal buttons now appear correctly when players receive permission during a tile reveal.

announcement.title: 🎁 Unboxing the Mystery v1.4.7
announcement.content:
Unboxing the Mystery v1.4.7 fixes initialization on route-prefixed Foundry servers and restores linked journal buttons during tile reveals.

  • Route-prefix hosting: Module settings and Tile HUD controls now register correctly when Foundry is hosted under a URL route prefix.
  • Hidden journal buttons: Linked journal buttons remain available when a player does not initially have permission, so permission changes work without reopening the tile.
